ai.title: Gabay sa Fractions (Mga Praksyon)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang fraction ay kumakatawan sa bahagi ng isang kabuuan. May dalawang pangunahing bahagi: numerator (taas) at denominator (baba).

🔍 Breakdown
• Proper Fraction — numerator < denominator
• Improper Fraction — numerator ≥ denominator
• Mixed Number — whole number + proper fraction
• Equivalent Fractions — magkaibang numero, parehong halaga
• Operations: Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Isipin mo na pizza na hinati sa 4 na slice. Kung kumuha ka ng 3, ang fraction mo ay 3/4. Ang 4 ay denominator (kabuuang slices), ang 3 ay numerator (kinuha mo).

📦 Halimbawa
• Proper: 3/4
• Improper: 5/2 = 2 1/2
• Equivalent: 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Ang fractions ay pundasyon ng maraming math problems sa CSE — ratios, percentages, at word problems.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
• Sa addition at subtraction, kailangang magkapareho muna ang denominator.
• Sa multiplication, i-multiply ang numerator sa numerator at denominator sa denominator.
• Sa division, i-reciprocal (baliktarin) ang pangalawang fraction bago mag-multiply.

🎯 Exam Tip
Sa CSE, madalas may fraction operations. Alamin ang LCD (Least Common Denominator) para mabilis ang addition at subtraction.
ai.prompt: Explain fractions (proper, improper, mixed, equivalent) and the four basic operations with step-by-step examples, plus common Civil Service Exam traps.

ai.title: Ano ang Fraction?
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang fraction ay kumakatawan sa bahagi ng isang kabuuan o bilang na nagpapakita ng paghahati.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Mayroon itong dalawang bahagi: numerator (nasa itaas, kung ilang bahagi ang kinukuha) at denominator (nasa ibaba, kung ilang pantay na bahagi hinati ang kabuuan).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Numerator sa itaas, denominator sa ibaba. Hindi pwedeng zero ang denominator.
ai.prompt: Explain what a fraction is, its parts (numerator and denominator), and give simple examples.

paragraphs.text: A fraction represents a part of a whole or a number that expresses division. It consists of two main parts: the numerator (the top number, which indicates how many parts are being considered) and the denominator (the bottom number, which indicates the total number of equal parts).

ai.title: Kahulugan ng Fraction
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang fraction ay bahagi ng isang buo o bilang na nagpapakita ng paghahati.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Binubuo ito ng numerator (taas) at denominator (baba). Ang numerator ay kung ilang bahagi ang kinukuha; ang denominator ay kung ilang pantay na bahagi ang kabuuan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: sa 3/4, ang 3 ay numerator at ang 4 ay denominator.
ai.prompt: Explain this definition of a fraction with simple real-life examples.

ai.title: Mga Uri ng Fractions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Apat na uri ng fractions: proper, improper, mixed number, at equivalent.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Tingnan lang ang numerator at denominator: kung mas maliit ang numerator, proper; kung mas malaki o pantay, improper. Ang mixed number ay may buong bilang at fraction. Ang equivalent ay magkaiba ang itsura pero pareho ang halaga.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang improper fraction ay pwedeng gawing mixed number. Ang equivalent fractions ay nakukuha sa pamamagitan ng multiply o divide ng numerator at denominator sa parehong numero.
ai.prompt: Explain the four types of fractions with examples and how they convert into each other.

paragraphs.label: Proper Fraction:
paragraphs.text: A fraction whose numerator is smaller than its denominator.

ai.title: Proper Fraction
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang proper fraction ay may numerator na mas maliit kaysa denominator.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Mas mababa sa 1 ang value nito — kasi mas kaunti ang kinuha kaysa sa buong hinati.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: 3/4, 1/2, 5/8 — lahat proper fractions.
ai.prompt: Explain proper fractions with examples and why their value is less than 1.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: 3/4 means 3 out of 4 equal parts.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Proper Fraction
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit proper fraction ang 3/4?
Sagot: Dahil mas maliit ang numerator (3) kaysa denominator (4). Ibig sabihin, kumuha ka ng 3 bahagi mula sa 4 na pantay na bahagi.
ai.prompt: Explain why 3/4 is a proper fraction with a real-life example.

paragraphs.label: Improper Fraction:
paragraphs.text: A fraction whose numerator is greater than or equal to its denominator.

ai.title: Improper Fraction
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang improper fraction ay may numerator na mas malaki o pantay sa denominator.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang value nito ay 1 o higit pa — kasi pantay o lumampas na ang kinuha sa buong hinati.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: 5/2, 7/4, 9/9 — lahat improper fractions.
ai.prompt: Explain improper fractions with examples and how they convert to mixed numbers.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: 5/2, which is equivalent to 2 1/2.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Improper Fraction
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging 2 1/2 ang 5/2?
Sagot: I-divide ang 5 sa 2 = 2 remainder 1. Kaya 2 1/2. Ang 2 ay buong bilang, ang 1/2 ay natirang fraction.
ai.prompt: Explain how to convert 5/2 into the mixed number 2 1/2 step by step.

paragraphs.label: Mixed Number:
paragraphs.text: A number consisting of a whole number and a proper fraction.

ai.title: Mixed Number
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang mixed number ay binubuo ng buong bilang at proper fraction.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kombinasyon ito — may buong bahagi at may fraction na bahagi.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: 2 1/2, 3 3/4, 5 1/8 — lahat mixed numbers.
ai.prompt: Explain mixed numbers with examples and how they relate to improper fractions.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Mixed Number
ai.content:
Tanong: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng 2 1/2?
Sagot: Ibig sabihin, may 2 buong yunit at 1/2 pang bahagi. Katumbas ito ng improper fraction na 5/2.
ai.prompt: Explain the mixed number 2 1/2 with a real-life example.

paragraphs.label: Equivalent Fractions:
paragraphs.text: Fractions that have different numerators and denominators but represent the same value.

ai.title: Equivalent Fractions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang equivalent fractions ay magkaiba ang numerator at denominator pero pareho ang halaga.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Parang iba-ibang damit pero iisang tao — magkaiba ang itsura, pareho ang value.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Nakukuha ito sa pag-multiply o pag-divide ng numerator at denominator sa parehong numero.
ai.prompt: Explain equivalent fractions with examples and how to find them.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Equivalent Fractions
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit equivalent ang 1/2, 2/4, at 4/8?
Sagot: I-multiply lang ang numerator at denominator sa parehong numero: 1×2/2×2 = 2/4; 2×2/4×2 = 4/8. Pareho silang 0.5 ang value.
ai.prompt: Explain why 1/2, 2/4, and 4/8 are equivalent fractions.

ai.title: Mga Operasyon sa Fractions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Apat na basic operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, at division.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang addition at subtraction ay kailangan ng common denominator. Ang multiplication ay direkta lang (numerator × numerator, denominator × denominator). Ang division ay i-reciprocal ang second fraction bago mag-multiply.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Pinakamadaling pagkakamali: mag-add ng fractions na hindi pareho ang denominator. Laging hanapin ang LCD muna.
ai.prompt: Explain the four basic operations on fractions with step-by-step examples and common mistakes.

paragraphs.label: 1. Addition:
paragraphs.text: Find a common denominator before adding the numerators.

ai.title: Addition of Fractions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sa addition, kailangang magkapareho muna ang denominator bago mag-add ng numerators.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi pwedeng direkta ang addition kung magkaiba ang denominator. Hanapin muna ang LCD (Least Common Denominator).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Pag pareho na ang denominator, i-add lang ang numerators at i-keep ang denominator.
ai.prompt: Explain how to add fractions with different denominators step by step.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Addition
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging 3/4 ang 1/2 + 1/4?
Sagot: Ang LCD ng 2 at 4 ay 4. Gawing 2/4 ang 1/2 (multiply numerator at denominator sa 2). Tapos 2/4 + 1/4 = 3/4.
ai.prompt: Explain the step-by-step solution for 1/2 + 1/4.

paragraphs.label: 2. Subtraction:
paragraphs.text: Find a common denominator before subtracting the numerators.

ai.title: Subtraction of Fractions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sa subtraction, kailangan din ng common denominator bago mag-subtract ng numerators.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pareho lang sa addition — common denominator muna, tapos subtract.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Pag pareho na ang denominator, i-subtract lang ang numerators at i-keep ang denominator.
ai.prompt: Explain how to subtract fractions with different denominators step by step.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Subtraction
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit 1/2 ang 3/4 − 1/4?
Sagot: Pareho na ang denominator (4), kaya 3−1 = 2. Kaya 2/4. I-simplify: 2/4 = 1/2.
ai.prompt: Explain the step-by-step solution for 3/4 − 1/4.

paragraphs.label: 3. Multiplication:
paragraphs.text: Multiply the numerators together and the denominators together.

ai.title: Multiplication of Fractions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sa multiplication, direkta lang — numerator × numerator, denominator × denominator.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi kailangan ng common denominator sa multiplication. Direkta lang ang multiply.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Pagkatapos mag-multiply, i-simplify ang sagot kung posible.
ai.prompt: Explain how to multiply fractions step by step.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Multiplication
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging 1/2 ang 2/3 × 3/4?
Sagot: 2×3 = 6 (numerator); 3×4 = 12 (denominator). Kaya 6/12. I-simplify: 6/12 = 1/2.
ai.prompt: Explain the step-by-step solution for 2/3 × 3/4.

paragraphs.label: 4. Division:
paragraphs.text: Keep the first fraction, change division into multiplication, and invert the second fraction.

ai.title: Division of Fractions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Sa division, i-keep ang first fraction, gawing multiplication ang division sign, at i-reciprocal (baliktarin) ang second fraction.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang reciprocal ng 1/4 ay 4/1. Kaya ang 1/2 ÷ 1/4 ay nagiging 1/2 × 4/1.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tandaan ang rule: Keep-Change-Flip (Keep first, Change ÷ to ×, Flip second).
ai.prompt: Explain how to divide fractions using the Keep-Change-Flip rule with examples.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Division
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit 2 ang 1/2 ÷ 1/4?
Sagot: Keep 1/2, change ÷ to ×, flip 1/4 to 4/1. Kaya 1/2 × 4/1 = 4/2 = 2.
ai.prompt: Explain the step-by-step solution for 1/2 ÷ 1/4.

ai.title: Gabay sa Percentages (Porsyento)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang percentage ay paraan ng pagpapahayag ng numero o proporsyon bilang fraction ng 100. Symbol: %.

🔍 Breakdown
• Finding the percentage of a number
• Finding what percentage one number is of another
• Percentage discount
• Percentage increase

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang percentage ay "bahagi ng isang daan." Para gawing decimal, ilipat ang decimal point ng dalawang puwesto pakaliwa. 50% = 0.50, 25% = 0.25, 10% = 0.10.

📦 Halimbawa
• 20% of 500 = 0.20 × 500 = 100
• 40/50 × 100 = 80%
• ₱800 with 25% discount = ₱600
• ₱500 → ₱600 = 20% increase

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Madalas ito sa CSE — discounts, exam scores, interest, at statistics.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
• 50% = 0.50 = 1/2
• 25% = 0.25 = 1/4
• 10% = 0.10 = 1/10
• 100% = 1.00 = buong halaga

🎯 Exam Tip
Sa discount problems, i-multiply ang original price sa discount rate para makuha ang discount amount, tapos i-subtract sa original price.

ai.title: Ano ang Percentage?
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang percentage ay paraan ng pagpapahayag ng numero bilang fraction ng 100.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ginagamit ito sa discounts, taxes, interest rates, exam scores, profits, at statistical comparisons.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang % ay nangangahulugang "per hundred" — kaya 20% ay 20/100 o 0.20.
ai.prompt: Explain what a percentage is and where it is commonly used.

paragraphs.text: A percentage is a way of expressing a number or proportion as a fraction of 100. It is represented by the symbol (%) and is commonly used in calculating discounts, taxes, interest rates, examination scores, profits, and statistical comparisons.

ai.title: Kahulugan ng Percentage
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang percentage ay nagpapahayag ng numero bilang bahagi ng 100. Symbol: %.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ginagamit ito sa maraming bagay: discounts sa tindahan, tax, interest sa bangko, exam scores, at statistics.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang 20% ay katumbas ng 20/100 o 0.20. Ang 100% ay ang buong halaga.
ai.prompt: Explain this definition of percentage with everyday examples.

ai.title: Mga Formula sa Percentage
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Apat na pangunahing konsepto: finding percentage, finding rate, discount, at increase.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang bawat isa ay may sariling formula. Alamin kung ano ang hinahanap: percentage (bahagi), rate (%), o base (buo).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
P = R × B (Percentage = Rate × Base). Ito ang pinaka-pundasyon na formula.
ai.prompt: Explain the four main percentage formulas with examples.

paragraphs.label: 1. Finding the Percentage of a Number:
paragraphs.text: Convert the percentage into a decimal, then multiply it by the given number.

ai.title: Finding the Percentage
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Para hanapin ang percentage ng isang numero, gawing decimal ang % at i-multiply sa numero.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
20% → 0.20. Tapos 0.20 × 500 = 100.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ilipat ang decimal point ng dalawang puwesto pakaliwa para gawing decimal ang %.
ai.prompt: Explain how to find the percentage of a number with examples.

ai.title: Halimbawa: 20% of 500
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging 100 ang 20% ng 500?
Sagot: 20% = 0.20. Tapos 0.20 × 500 = 100.
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how to compute 20% of 500.

paragraphs.label: 2. Finding What Percentage One Number Is of Another:
paragraphs.text: Divide the part by the whole, then multiply by 100.

ai.title: Finding the Rate (%)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Para malaman kung ilang % ang isang numero sa isa pa, i-divide ang part sa whole, tapos i-multiply sa 100.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Formula: (Part ÷ Whole) × 100 = Rate.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang "part" ay ang maliit na bahagi; ang "whole" ay ang buong halaga.
ai.prompt: Explain how to find what percentage one number is of another.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A student gets 40 correct answers out of 50 questions. What is the percentage? 40/50 × 100 = 80%

ai.title: Halimbawa: 40 out of 50
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging 80% ang 40/50?
Sagot: (40 ÷ 50) × 100 = 0.80 × 100 = 80%.
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how to compute the percentage for 40 out of 50.

paragraphs.label: 3. Percentage Discount:
paragraphs.text: Multiply the original price by the discount rate to find the discount amount. Subtract it from the original price to get the sale price.

ai.title: Percentage Discount
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Para makuha ang sale price, i-multiply ang original price sa discount rate para makuha ang discount, tapos i-subtract sa original price.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Original Price − Discount = Sale Price. Ang discount = Original × Rate.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Huwag kalimutang i-subtract ang discount sa original price para makuha ang final na babayaran.
ai.prompt: Explain how to calculate a percentage discount step by step.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A shirt costs ₱800 with a 25% discount. 800 × 0.25 = ₱200; 800 − 200 = ₱600. Final Sale Price: ₱600

ai.title: Halimbawa: 25% Discount
ai.content:
Tanong: Magkano ang babayaran sa ₱800 shirt na may 25% discount?
Sagot: Discount = 800 × 0.25 = ₱200. Sale price = 800 − 200 = ₱600.
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how to compute a 25% discount on an ₱800 shirt.

paragraphs.label: 4. Percentage Increase:
paragraphs.text: Subtract the original value from the new value, divide by the original value, and multiply by 100.

ai.title: Percentage Increase
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Para malaman ang % increase: (New − Original) ÷ Original × 100.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
I-subtract ang original sa new, i-divide sa original, tapos i-multiply sa 100.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang denominator ay laging ang ORIGINAL value, hindi ang new value.
ai.prompt: Explain how to calculate percentage increase step by step.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A product increases in price from ₱500 to ₱600. (600 − 500)/500 × 100 = 20%

ai.title: Halimbawa: 20% Increase

ai.title: Gabay sa Ratios and Proportions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang ratio ay paghahambing ng dalawa o higit pang dami. Ang proportion ay equation na nagpapakita ng pagkakapantay ng dalawang ratio.

🔍 Breakdown
• Writing ratios (12:16)
• Simplifying ratios (GCF)
• Proportions (2:4 = 3:6)
• Cross multiplication
• Partitive proportion

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang ratio ay parang "3 lalaki sa 4 na babae." Ang proportion ay "kung 2:4, dapat 3:6 din." Ang partitive proportion ay paghahati ng total base sa ratio.

📦 Halimbawa
• 12 boys : 16 girls = 3:4
• 2/3 = x/12 → x = 8
• ₱1,000 in 2:3 → ₱400 at ₱600

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Maraming CSE problems ang tungkol sa ratios at proportions — mixtures, recipes, sharing money, at scaled drawings.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
• GCF ang gamit sa pag-simplify.
• Cross multiplication para sa missing value.
• Mahalaga ang order: 2:3 ≠ 3:2.

🎯 Exam Tip
Sa partitive proportion, i-add muna ang ratio terms, divide ang total, tapos i-multiply sa bawat term.
ai.prompt: Explain ratios and proportions in simple Tagalog, including simplifying, cross multiplication, and partitive proportion.

ai.title: Ano ang Ratio at Proportion?
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang ratio ay paghahambing ng dalawang dami. Ang proportion ay equation na nagpapakita ng pagkakapantay ng dalawang ratio.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ratio: 12:16. Proportion: 2:4 = 3:6 (pareho silang 1:2).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang ratio ay pwedeng isulat sa colon (:) o fraction. Ang proportion ay may equal sign.
ai.prompt: Explain the difference between ratio and proportion with examples.

paragraphs.text: A ratio is a mathematical comparison between two or more quantities of the same kind. It shows the relationship between quantities and can be written using a colon (:), as a fraction, or using the word "to." A proportion is an equation that states that two ratios are equal.

ai.title: Kahulugan ng Ratio at Proportion
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang ratio ay paghahambing ng dalawang dami (12:16). Ang proportion ay equation na nagpapakita ng pagkakapantay ng dalawang ratio (2:4 = 3:6).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang ratio ay naghahambing; ang proportion ay nagpapatunay na pareho sila ng value.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang ratio ay pwedeng isulat sa colon, fraction, o word form ("to").
ai.prompt: Explain this definition of ratio and proportion with examples.

ai.title: Mga Konsepto sa Ratio at Proportion
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Limang konsepto: writing, simplifying, identifying proportions, solving, at partitive.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawat isa ay may tamang paraan. Ang simplifying ay GCF; ang solving ay cross multiplication; ang partitive ay total ÷ sum of ratios.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang cross multiplication ay (a/b = c/d) → ad = bc.
ai.prompt: Explain the five key concepts in ratios and proportions.

paragraphs.label: 1. Writing Ratios:
paragraphs.text: A classroom has 12 boys and 16 girls. Ratio of boys to girls: 12:16. The ratio in simplest form: 12:16 = 3:4.

ai.title: Writing Ratios
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang ratio ay sinusulat sa colon form (12:16) o fraction form (12/16).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang 12:16 ay nagiging 3:4 kapag pinasimple (divide both by 4).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang order ay mahalaga: boys:girls = 12:16, hindi 16:12.
ai.prompt: Explain how to write and simplify ratios with examples.

paragraphs.label: 2. Simplifying Ratios:
paragraphs.text: Divide all terms of the ratio by their Greatest Common Factor (GCF). 18:24 — GCF is 6 — 18÷6 : 24÷6 = 3:4.

ai.title: Simplifying Ratios
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Para i-simplify ang ratio, i-divide ang lahat ng terms sa GCF.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
GCF ng 18 at 24 ay 6. Kaya 18:24 → 3:4.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hanapin ang GCF ng lahat ng terms bago mag-divide.
ai.prompt: Explain how to simplify ratios using GCF with examples.

paragraphs.label: 3. Proportion:
paragraphs.text: Two ratios are proportional when they have the same value. 2:4 = 3:6 — both ratios are equivalent to 1:2.

ai.title: Proportion
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang proportion ay equation na nagsasabi na pareho ang value ng dalawang ratio.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
2:4 = 3:6 dahil pareho silang 1:2 kapag pinasimple.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang proportion ay may equal sign; ang ratio ay wala.
ai.prompt: Explain how to identify proportional ratios with examples.

paragraphs.label: 4. Solving Proportions:
paragraphs.text: Use cross multiplication to find the missing value. 2/3 = x/12 — cross multiply: 3x = 24 — x = 8.

ai.title: Solving Proportions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Para hanapin ang missing value, gamitin ang cross multiplication.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
2/3 = x/12 → 3 × x = 2 × 12 → 3x = 24 → x = 8.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
I-multiply ang numerator ng isang side sa denominator ng kabilang side.
ai.prompt: Explain how to solve proportions using cross multiplication with step-by-step examples.

paragraphs.label: 5. Partitive Proportion:
paragraphs.text: This involves dividing a total amount into shares based on a given ratio. Example: Divide ₱1,000 in the ratio 2:3. Step 1: Add the ratio terms (2+3=5). Step 2: Divide the total amount by 5 (₱1,000÷5=₱200). Step 3: Multiply each ratio term by ₱200. First share: 2×200=₱400. Second share: 3×200=₱600. Final Answer: ₱400 and ₱600.

ai.title: Partitive Proportion
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang partitive proportion ay paghahati ng total base sa isang ratio.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hakbang: (1) Add ratio terms (2+3=5). (2) Total ÷ sum (1000÷5=200). (3) Multiply each term (2×200=400; 3×200=600).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Laging i-add muna ang ratio terms bago mag-divide ng total.
ai.prompt: Explain how to solve partitive proportion problems step by step with examples.

ai.title: Gabay sa Word Problems
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang word problems ay math exercises na nakasulat sa sentences o story form.

🔍 Breakdown
• Steps: Read, Identify Given, Identify Asked, Choose Operation, Solve, Check
• Keywords table
• Examples: Age, Distance, Average

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi sapat na makita ang numero — kailangan intindihin ang buong sitwasyon. Basahin muna bago mag-compute.

📦 Halimbawa
• Age: Maria is 5 years older than Juan, sum = 25 → Juan = 10, Maria = 15
• Distance: D = R × T = 60 × 3.5 = 210 km
• Average: (80+90+100)/3 = 90

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Ang word problems ang pinaka-praktikal na application ng math sa totoong buhay at sa CSE.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang keywords ay clues, hindi absolute rules. Basahin ang buong sentence — may "less than" na nagbabago ng order ng subtraction.

🔍 Breakdown

• Arithmetic Progression — constant addition/subtraction
• Geometric Progression — constant multiplication/division
• Alternating Series — dalawang pattern na salitan

• Increasing Difference — +1, +2, +3, +4...

• Arithmetic: 2, 5, 8, 11 → next = 14 (+3)
• Geometric: 3, 6, 12, 24 → next = 48 (×2)
• Alternating: 2, 5, 4, 10, 6, 15 → next = 8
• Squares: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25 → next = 36 (6²)
• Cubes: 1, 8, 27, 64 → next = 125 (5³)

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi constant ang difference — kaya kailangan mong hanapin ang pattern ng differences mismo.

paragraphs.text: 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, ? Solution: Differences: +1, +2, +3, +4. Next difference is +5. 12+5 = 17. Answer: 17

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Increasing Difference
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging 17 ang susunod?
Sagot: Ang differences ay +1, +2, +3, +4 — tumataas ng 1 bawat step. Kaya next difference ay +5: 12 + 5 = 17.

ai.title: Gabay sa Logic (Lohika)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang logic ay ang kakayahang mag-isip nang malinaw, magsuri ng impormasyon, at makabuo ng tamang konklusyon gamit ang mga ibinigay na pahayag.

🔍 Breakdown
Anim na uri ng logical reasoning:
• Syllogism — conclusion mula sa statements
• Blood Relations — family relationships
• Direction Sense — directions at movements
• Seating Arrangement — positioning
• Coding and Decoding — letter/number patterns
• Deductive at Inductive Reasoning — general to specific at vice versa

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi ito hula — kailangan mong gamitin ang mga detalye at relasyon para makuha ang lohikal na sagot. Kung may given information, yun lang ang gamitin. Huwag mag-imbento ng sariling assumptions.

📦 Halimbawa
• Syllogism: All cats are animals. All animals need water. → All cats need water.
• Blood Relations: John is son of Mary's brother → John is Mary's nephew.
• Coding: CAT → DBU (bawat letter +1) → DOG → EPH

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Malaking bahagi ng CSE Analytical Ability. Sinusukat nito ang iyong critical thinking at attention to detail.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Gamitin lamang ang impormasyong nasa problem. Huwag magdagdag ng sariling palagay na wala sa given.

🎯 Exam Tip
Sa logic problems, isulat ang mga given sa bullet form at i-drawing (kung kailangan) para mas malinaw ang relationships.

Ang logic ay kakayahang mag-isip nang malinaw at gumawa ng tamang konklusyon base sa given information.

Ang logic ay kakayahang mag-isip nang malinaw at magbigay ng tamang konklusyon base sa facts.

ai.title: Mga Uri ng Logical Reasoning
ai.content:

Anim na uri: syllogism, blood relations, direction sense, seating arrangement, coding/decoding, deductive/inductive.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawat isa ay may unique approach. Ang syllogism ay tungkol sa validity ng conclusion; ang blood relations ay tungkol sa family tree; ang coding ay tungkol sa letter shifts.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Sa bawat uri, may tamang method — hindi basta hula.
ai.prompt: Explain the six types of logical reasoning with examples.

paragraphs.label: 1. Syllogism:
paragraphs.text: A reasoning method that uses two or more statements to determine whether a conclusion logically follows.

ai.title: Syllogism
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang syllogism ay gumagamit ng dalawa o higit pang statements para tukuyin kung lohikal ang conclusion.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Rule of thumb: kung general statement → specific case, dapat mag-follow ang conclusion.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi porke may valid form, true ang conclusion — kailangang true din ang premises.
ai.prompt: Explain syllogism with clear examples of valid and invalid reasoning.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: Statement 1: All cats are animals. Statement 2: All animals need water. Conclusion: Therefore, all cats need water. Answer: The conclusion is logically valid.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Syllogism
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit valid ang conclusion?
Sagot: Kung lahat ng cats ay animals, at lahat ng animals ay nangangailangan ng water — kung gayon, lahat ng cats ay nangangailangan ng water. Transitive property ito.
ai.prompt: Explain step by step why this syllogism is valid.

paragraphs.label: 2. Blood Relations:
paragraphs.text: Questions that test your ability to identify family relationships based on given information.

ai.title: Blood Relations
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang blood relations ay tungkol sa family ties — mother, father, sibling, uncle, aunt, nephew, niece, etc.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
I-drawing ang family tree para malinaw ang relationships. I-identify ang gender at generation ng bawat tao.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Mag-ingat sa gender pronouns (he/she) — malaking clue ito sa relasyon.
ai.prompt: Explain how to solve blood relation problems with a family tree.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: John is the son of Mary's brother. How is John related to Mary? Solution: Mary's brother is John's father. John is the son of Mary's brother. Therefore, John is Mary's nephew. Answer: Nephew

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Blood Relation
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging nephew si John ni Mary?
Sagot: Ang brother ni Mary ay ama ni John. Kaya si John ay anak ng kapatid ni Mary = pamangkin (nephew).
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how to solve this blood relation problem.

paragraphs.label: 3. Direction Sense:
paragraphs.text: Questions that test your ability to determine directions and movements.

ai.title: Direction Sense
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang direction sense ay tungkol sa pag-navigate — North, South, East, West, Northeast, Northwest, Southeast, Southwest.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
I-drawing ang path sa papel. I-set ang North sa taas, South sa baba, East sa kanan, West sa kaliwa.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
I-check ang "from" — mula sa starting point ba o mula sa current position ang hinihingi?
ai.prompt: Explain direction sense problems with a clear method.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A person walks 5 meters north, then 3 meters east. In which direction is the person from the starting point? Solution: The person is now northeast of the starting point. Answer: Northeast

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Direction
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit Northeast ang sagot?
Sagot: Pahilaga 5m, tapos pasilangan 3m. From starting point, nasa northeast direction siya — combination ng North at East.
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how to determine the direction in this problem.

paragraphs.label: 4. Seating Arrangement:
paragraphs.text: Questions that require arranging people or objects according to specific conditions.

ai.title: Seating Arrangement
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang seating arrangement ay tungkol sa positioning ng mga tao o bagay base sa given conditions.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
I-drawing ang row (o circle) at i-place ang bawat tao base sa clues. Start sa pinaka-specific clue.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
I-check ang left/right pag nakaharap sa iba — nag-iiba ito depende sa perspective.
ai.prompt: Explain seating arrangement problems with a clear method.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: Ana, Ben, and Carlo are sitting in a row. Ana is on the left of Ben, and Carlo is on the right of Ben. Who is in the middle? Solution: Ana — Ben — Carlo. Answer: Ben

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Seating
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging Ben ang nasa gitna?
Sagot: Si Ana ay nasa kaliwa ni Ben, si Carlo ay nasa kanan ni Ben. Kaya ang order: Ana-Ben-Carlo. Nasa gitna si Ben.
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how to solve this seating arrangement.

paragraphs.label: 5. Coding and Decoding:
paragraphs.text: Questions that involve changing letters, numbers, or words according to a specific rule.

ai.title: Coding and Decoding
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang coding at decoding ay tungkol sa patterns ng letters o numbers — shifts, reversals, substitutions.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hanapin ang shift sa unang letter: A→B (+1), A→C (+2), A→Z (-1).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Karaniwang patterns: +1, +2, -1, -2, reverse order, alternating shifts.
ai.prompt: Explain coding and decoding with letter shift examples.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: If CAT is coded as DBU, how is DOG coded using the same pattern? Solution: Each letter moves one position forward in the alphabet. D→E, O→P, G→H. Answer: EPH

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Coding
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano naging EPH ang DOG?
Sagot: Ang pattern ay +1 sa bawat letter: C→D, A→B, T→U (CAT→DBU). Kaya D→E, O→P, G→H (DOG→EPH).
ai.prompt: Explain step by step how to decode DOG using the same pattern as CAT→DBU.

paragraphs.label: 6. Deductive and Inductive Reasoning:
paragraphs.text: Deductive Reasoning: Uses general information or rules to reach a specific conclusion. Inductive Reasoning: Uses repeated observations to identify a possible general pattern.

ai.title: Deductive vs Inductive
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Deductive: general rule → specific conclusion. Inductive: specific observations → general conclusion.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Deductive ay "top-down" (rule muna). Inductive ay "bottom-up" (observations muna).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang deductive ay certain (kung valid); ang inductive ay probable lang (hindi 100% sure).
ai.prompt: Explain deductive and inductive reasoning with examples.

paragraphs.label: Example (Deductive):
paragraphs.text: All humans need oxygen. Mark is human. Therefore, Mark needs oxygen.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Deductive
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit deductive ito?
Sagot: General rule (all humans need oxygen) → specific case (Mark is human → Mark needs oxygen).
ai.prompt: Explain why this is deductive reasoning.

paragraphs.label: Example (Inductive):
paragraphs.text: The sun has risen every morning observed so far. Therefore, it is reasonable to expect the sun to rise tomorrow.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Inductive
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit inductive ito?
Sagot: Repeated observations (araw-araw sumisikat ang araw) → general conclusion (aasahan nating sisikat ulit bukas). Pero probable lang, hindi 100% certain.
ai.prompt: Explain why this is inductive reasoning.

ai.title: Gabay sa Figures and Patterns
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang figures and pattern questions ay non-verbal reasoning — gumagamit ng hugis, simbolo, at visual arrangements.

🔍 Breakdown
Pitong uri:
• Rotation — umiikot sa angle
• Reflection — mirror image
• Size Progression — lumalaki/lumiliit
• Element Counting — dumarami ang elements
• Shape Alternation — paulit-ulit na shapes
• Position Movement — gumagalaw sa grid
• Missing Figure — tukuyin ang kulang

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Obserbahan kung paano nagbabago ang figure sa bawat step. I-check: direksyon, size, bilang ng elements, position, at repetition.

📦 Halimbawa
• Rotation: UP → RIGHT → DOWN → LEFT (90° clockwise)
• Mirror: → ← (horizontal reflection)
• Counting: 1, 3, 5, 7 dots (+2)
• Alternation: Circle → Square → Triangle → Circle → Square → Triangle

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Test ng visual-spatial intelligence at pattern recognition. Madalas sa CSE Analytical Ability.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Tingnan ang direksyon, laki, bilang ng elements, at posisyon. I-count ang lines, dots, at shapes.

🎯 Exam Tip
Sa rotation, i-check kung clockwise o counterclockwise at gaano kalaki ang angle. Sa mirror, i-check kung horizontal o vertical ang flip.

Non-verbal reasoning na gumagamit ng hugis at visuals sa halip na words o numbers.

ai.prompt: Explain the seven types of figure patterns with examples.

paragraphs.label: 1. Rotation Pattern:
paragraphs.text: A figure changes its direction or orientation by rotating at a consistent angle.

ai.title: Rotation Pattern

I-check kung clockwise o counterclockwise ang ikot.

Ang 90° clockwise ay: UP → RIGHT → DOWN → LEFT.

paragraphs.label: 2. Reflection or Mirror Image:

Ang figure ay binaliktad (flip) — either horizontally (left-right) o vertically (up-down).

Ang shapes ay lumalaki o lumiliit sa bawat step.

Obserbahan kung dumarami ba ang laki (growing) o bumababa (shrinking).

I-check ang ratio ng sizes — palaging doble ba, o pare-pareho ang dagdag?

Ang bilang ng objects/elements ay dumarami o bumababa sa bawat figure.

I-count ang dots, lines, o shapes — may pattern (+2, +3, ×2, etc.).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
I-check kung constant ba ang dagdag o pattern (1, 3, 5, 7 = +2).

paragraphs.label: Example:

paragraphs.label: 5. Shape and Symbol Alternation:

ai.title: Shape Alternation
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang shapes ay paulit-ulit sa pattern (cycle).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
I-identify ang cycle: Circle → Square → Triangle → (repeat).

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hanapin ang cycle length — 2 shapes ba, 3 shapes, o 4?
ai.prompt: Explain shape alternation patterns.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: Circle → Square → Triangle → Circle → Square → ? Answer: Triangle

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Alternation

Tanong: Bakit Triangle ang sagot?
Sagot: Cycle ng 3 shapes: Circle, Square, Triangle. Kaya pagkatapos ng Circle → Square, susunod ay Triangle.

paragraphs.label: 6. Position and Movement Pattern:
paragraphs.text: An object changes its position within a box, grid, or diagram according to a specific direction or sequence.

ai.title: Position and Movement

Ang object ay gumagalaw sa loob ng grid/box base sa direction at sequence.

I-track ang path: gumagalaw ba clockwise? Counterclockwise? Diagonal?

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
I-check kung may step pattern ang movement (1 position ba, 2 positions, etc.).
ai.prompt: Explain position and movement patterns.

paragraphs.label: Example:

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Position Movement
ai.content:
Tanong: Bakit lower-left ang sagot?

paragraphs.label: 7. Missing Figure:

Tingnan ang pattern ng iba pang sections — dapat mag-follow ng rule.

ai.content:

ai.title: Gabay sa Philippine Constitution
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang 1987 Philippine Constitution ay ang pinakamataas na batas sa Pilipinas. Dito nakasaad ang mga pangunahing prinsipyo ng ating pamahalaan, ang kapangyarihan at tungkulin ng bawat sangay nito, at ang mga karapatan at kalayaan ng mga mamamayan.

🔍 Breakdown
• Supremacy of the Constitution — pinakamataas na batas, walang nakahihigit
• Three Branches — Executive (nagpapatupad), Legislative (gumagawa ng batas), Judicial (nagbibigay-kahulugan)
• Separation of Powers at Checks and Balances
• Bill of Rights (Article III)
• Citizenship (Article IV)

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang Constitution ay parang "rules ng bahay" ng buong bansa — lahat, kahit ang Pangulo, ay kailangang sumunod dito. Hinahati nito ang kapangyarihan sa tatlong sangay para walang sinuman ang magkaroon ng walang limitasyong kapangyarihan.

📦 Halimbawa
• Supremacy: Kahit ang Pangulo ay kailangang sumunod sa Konstitusyon.
• Legislative: Ang Kongreso ang gumagawa at nagpapasa ng mga batas.
• Executive: Ang Pangulo at mga ahensya ang nagpapatupad.
• Judicial: Ang mga hukuman ang nagbibigay-kahulugan sa batas.
• Bill of Rights: Karapatan ng isang tao na magpahayag ng opinyon, basta sumusunod sa batas.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Pundasyon ito ng lahat ng batas sa Pilipinas. Madalas itong lumabas sa CSE — constitutional articles, branches of government, at Bill of Rights.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Mga articles na madalas lumabas:
• Article II — Declaration of Principles and State Policies
• Article III — Bill of Rights
• Article IV — Citizenship
• Article VI — Legislative Department
• Article VII — Executive Department
• Article VIII — Judicial Department

🎯 Exam Tip
I-memorize ang article numbers at ang kanilang subject. Madalas ang tanong: "Anong article ang Bill of Rights?" (Article III) o "Anong article ang Citizenship?" (Article IV).

ai.content:
Tanong: Paano ipinapatupad ang supremacy?
Sagot: Ang Supreme Court ay may kapangyarihang i-declare na unconstitutional ang isang batas kung lumalabag ito sa Constitution.
ai.prompt: Explain how the Supreme Court enforces constitutional supremacy.

paragraphs.label: 2. Three Branches of Government:
paragraphs.text: The Philippine government is divided into three branches, each with distinct responsibilities.

ai.title: Tatlong Sangay ng Gobyerno
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang gobyerno ay nahahati sa tatlong branches: Executive, Legislative, Judicial.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawat branch ay may kanya-kanyang responsibilidad para hindi maipon ang kapangyarihan sa isang tao o grupo.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Executive = nagpapatupad; Legislative = gumagawa ng batas; Judicial = nagbibigay-kahulugan.
ai.prompt: Explain the three branches of the Philippine government.

paragraphs.label: Executive Branch:
paragraphs.text: Implements and enforces laws. Headed by the President of the Philippines.

ai.title: Executive Branch
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Executive Branch ay nagpapatupad at nag-eenforce ng mga batas. Pinamumunuan ng Pangulo.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kapag may bagong batas, ang Pangulo at mga ahensya (DOH, DepEd, DPWH, etc.) ang nagpapatupad nito.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Pangulo ay may veto power sa mga bill na ipinasa ng Congress.
ai.prompt: Explain the Executive Branch and its responsibilities.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: The President directs government agencies in implementing national policies.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Executive
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano nagpapatupad ang Pangulo?
Sagot: Sa pamamagitan ng mga ahensya ng gobyerno — halimbawa, pag-utos sa DepEd na magpatupad ng bagong curriculum.
ai.prompt: Explain how the President implements policies through agencies.

paragraphs.label: Legislative Branch:
paragraphs.text: Creates, amends, and repeals laws. Composed of the Senate and the House of Representatives, collectively known as Congress.

ai.title: Legislative Branch
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Legislative Branch (Congress) ang gumagawa, nag-aamend, at nag-repeal ng mga batas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Binubuo ng Senate (24 senators) at House of Representatives (mga congressman). Sila ang gumagawa ng batas.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang isang bill ay kailangang pumasa sa parehong Senate at House bago pumunta sa Pangulo para pirmahan.
ai.prompt: Explain the Legislative Branch and its law-making role.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: Congress passes a proposed law concerning taxation.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Legislative
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano gumagawa ng batas ang Congress?
Sagot: Isang proposed law (bill) ang pinag-debatehan at binoboto sa Senate at House. Kapag pasado sa dalawa, pupunta sa Pangulo para sa approval.
ai.prompt: Explain how Congress passes a law.

paragraphs.label: Judicial Branch:
paragraphs.text: Interprets laws and settles legal disputes. Headed by the Supreme Court.

ai.title: Judicial Branch
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Judicial Branch ay nagbibigay-kahulugan sa batas at lumulutas ng legal disputes. Pinamumunuan ng Supreme Court.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Sila ang nagde-determine kung ano ang ibig sabihin ng isang batas sa isang specific na sitwasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang Supreme Court ang may final say — kung unconstitutional, invalid ang batas.
ai.prompt: Explain the Judicial Branch and its role.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: The Supreme Court determines whether a government action violates the Constitution.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Judicial
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano nagbibigay-kahulugan ang Supreme Court?
Sagot: Kapag may question sa constitutionality ng isang batas o aksyon, ang Supreme Court ang nagde-decide kung valid ito o hindi.
ai.prompt: Explain how the Supreme Court reviews constitutionality.

paragraphs.label: 3. Separation of Powers and Checks and Balances:
paragraphs.text: These principles prevent any single branch of government from having unlimited authority.

ai.title: Separation of Powers at Checks and Balances
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang separation of powers ay naghahati ng kapangyarihan sa 3 branches. Ang checks and balances ay nagbibigay ng kapangyarihan sa bawat branch na i-check ang iba.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Walang branch ang pwedeng gumawa ng lahat — bawat isa ay may limitasyon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Hindi ito pareho: separation = hiwalay na roles; checks = bawat branch may power over ibang branches.
ai.prompt: Explain separation of powers and checks and balances.

paragraphs.label: Separation of Powers:
paragraphs.text: Each branch has its own constitutional responsibilities.

ai.title: Separation of Powers
ai.content:
Tanong: Ano ang separation of powers?
Sagot: Bawat branch ay may kanya-kanyang responsibilidad na hindi ginagawa ng ibang branch. Legislative = gumawa ng batas; Executive = magpatupad; Judicial = magbigay-kahulugan.
ai.prompt: Explain separation of powers in detail.

paragraphs.label: Checks and Balances:
paragraphs.text: Each branch has certain powers to limit or review the actions of the other branches.

ai.title: Checks and Balances
ai.content:
Tanong: Ano ang checks and balances?
Sagot: Bawat branch ay may power na i-review o limitahan ang iba. Halimbawa, ang Pangulo ay may veto, ang Congress ay may override, at ang Supreme Court ay may judicial review.
ai.prompt: Explain checks and balances with examples.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: The President may veto a bill passed by Congress, while Congress may override the veto under the constitutional requirements.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Checks and Balances
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano nag-i-check ang branches sa isa't isa?
Sagot: Pangulo → may veto sa bill ng Congress. Congress → may override ng veto (2/3 vote ng both houses). Supreme Court → may judicial review (ide-declare na unconstitutional).
ai.prompt: Explain the veto and override process as an example of checks and balances.

paragraphs.label: 4. Bill of Rights (Article III):
paragraphs.text: The Bill of Rights protects individuals against abuses of government power and guarantees fundamental freedoms.

ai.title: Bill of Rights (Article III)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Bill of Rights ay nagpoprotekta sa mga indibidwal laban sa abuse ng gobyerno. Nasa Article III ito ng Constitution.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Karapatan mo ito — hindi pwedeng bawiin ng gobyerno nang walang due process.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Article III = Bill of Rights. Madalas itong lumabas sa CSE.
ai.prompt: Explain the Bill of Rights and why it's in Article III.

paragraphs.text: Important rights include: freedom of speech and expression, freedom of religion, right to due process of law, equal protection of the laws, right against unreasonable searches and seizures, right to privacy of communication, right to a speedy and public trial.

ai.title: Mahahalagang Karapatan sa Bill of Rights
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pitong mahalagang karapatan sa Bill of Rights:

1. Freedom of speech and expression
2. Freedom of religion
3. Right to due process
4. Equal protection of the laws
5. Right against unreasonable searches and seizures
6. Right to privacy of communication
7. Right to speedy and public trial

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang lahat ng ito ay nagpoprotekta sa iyo laban sa abuse ng gobyerno.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang "due process" ay ang karapatang magkaroon ng tamang legal procedure bago ka parusahan o bawiin ng karapatan.
ai.prompt: Explain the key rights in the Bill of Rights with examples.

paragraphs.label: 5. Citizenship (Article IV):
paragraphs.text: The Constitution identifies who are considered citizens of the Philippines.

ai.title: Citizenship (Article IV)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang Article IV ay nagsasaad kung sino ang itinuturing na citizen ng Pilipinas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
May tatlong paraan: (1) natural-born (Filipino parent), (2) naturalization, (3) reacquisition.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Article IV = Citizenship. Madalas itong tanong sa exam.
ai.prompt: Explain Philippine citizenship under Article IV with examples.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A person whose father or mother is a Filipino citizen is generally considered a natural-born Filipino citizen, subject to the constitutional provisions.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng Citizenship
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano maging natural-born citizen?
Sagot: Kung ang ama o ina ay Filipino citizen, natural-born citizen ang anak. Hindi kailangang mag-naturalize.
ai.prompt: Explain natural-born citizenship through Filipino parents.

ai.title: Gabay sa RA 6713
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 6713 (Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees) ay batas na nagtatakda ng tamang asal, etika, at responsibilidad ng mga opisyal at empleyado ng pamahalaan.

🔍 Breakdown
• 8 Norms of Conduct (Section 4)
• Prohibited Acts and Transactions (Section 7)
• SALN (Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth)

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Layunin ng batas na ito na matiyak na ang mga lingkod-bayan ay nagtatrabaho nang tapat, patas, responsable, at may malasakit sa mga mamamayan. Ang pagiging empleyado ng gobyerno ay isang responsibilidad na dapat gamitin para sa kapakanan ng publiko — hindi para sa pansariling interes.

📦 Halimbawa
• Commitment to Public Interest: Dapat unahin ng empleyado ang kapakanan ng mamamayan kaysa sa sarili.
• Professionalism: Maayos at mahusay na gampanan ang trabaho.
• Political Neutrality: Hindi magkaiba ang serbisyo dahil sa partido.
• Simple Living: Mamuhay nang simple at naaayon sa lehitimong kinikita.
• Prohibited Gifts: Hindi tumanggap ng suhol.
• SALN: Ideklara ang mga ari-arian, utang, at net worth.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Ito ang batayan ng integridad ng serbisyo publiko. Madalas itong lumabas sa CSE — lalo na ang 8 norms at SALN.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Memorize ang 8 Norms of Conduct (Section 4):
1. Commitment to Public Interest
2. Professionalism
3. Justness and Sincerity
4. Political Neutrality
5. Responsiveness to the Public
6. Nationalism and Patriotism
7. Commitment to Democracy
8. Simple Living

🎯 Exam Tip
Mnemonic para sa 8 norms: CP-JP-RN-CS (Commitment, Professionalism, Justness, Political, Responsiveness, Nationalism, Commitment to Democracy, Simple Living).
ai.prompt: Explain RA 6713 in simple Tagalog — 8 norms of conduct, prohibited acts, and SALN — with CSE exam tips.

ai.title: Kahulugan ng RA 6713
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 6713 ay Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees, enacted noong February 20, 1989.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Layunin nito: honesty, integrity, accountability, professionalism, at responsibility sa serbisyo publiko.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Public interest > personal gain — ito ang core principle.
ai.prompt: Explain what RA 6713 is and its purpose.

paragraphs.text: Republic Act No. 6713, also known as the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees, is a Philippine law enacted on February 20, 1989. It establishes ethical standards and promotes honesty, integrity, accountability, professionalism, and responsibility among government officials and employees. Its main purpose is to ensure that public officials and employees serve the people honestly and prioritize public interest over personal gain.

ai.title: Ano ang RA 6713?
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 6713 ay batas na nagtatakda ng ethical standards sa mga public officials at employees. Naipasa noong February 20, 1989.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Layunin: tiyakin na ang mga lingkod-bayan ay tapat at inuuna ang public interest kaysa personal gain.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Public interest > personal gain — ito ang puso ng batas.
ai.prompt: Explain this definition of RA 6713 with examples.

ai.title: 8 Norms of Conduct
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Walong norms ng conduct ang dapat sundin ng bawat public official at employee.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawat norm ay may specific na meaning at application sa totoong buhay. Ito ang daily guide ng isang lingkod-bayan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Memorize ang 8 norms: Commitment to Public Interest, Professionalism, Justness and Sincerity, Political Neutrality, Responsiveness to the Public, Nationalism and Patriotism, Commitment to Democracy, Simple Living.
ai.prompt: Explain the eight norms of conduct under RA 6713 with examples.

paragraphs.label: 1. Commitment to Public Interest:
paragraphs.text: Public officials must prioritize the welfare and interests of the public rather than their personal benefits.

ai.title: Commitment to Public Interest
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Dapat unahin ng public official ang welfare ng publiko kaysa personal benefit.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang trabaho sa gobyerno ay para sa tao, hindi para sa sarili.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: Dapat patas ang pagproseso ng aplikasyon — hindi priority ang kaibigan o kamag-anak.
ai.prompt: Explain commitment to public interest with examples.

paragraphs.label: 2. Professionalism:
paragraphs.text: Government employees must perform their duties with competence, dedication, and excellence.

ai.title: Professionalism
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Dapat gampanan ang tungkulin nang may competence, dedication, at excellence.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Maayos at mahusay ang trabaho — hindi basta "pwede na."

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: Magbigay ng accurate information at tapusin ang tasks nang responsable.
ai.prompt: Explain professionalism in public service.

paragraphs.label: 3. Justness and Sincerity:
paragraphs.text: Public officials must treat everyone fairly, honestly, and without discrimination.

ai.title: Justness and Sincerity
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Patas, tapat, at walang diskriminasyon ang pagtrato sa lahat.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Pareho ang serbisyo sa mayaman at mahirap — walang favoritism.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: Equal service sa lahat ng mamamayan.
ai.prompt: Explain justness and sincerity with examples.

paragraphs.label: 4. Political Neutrality:
paragraphs.text: Government employees must provide services without unfairly favoring or discriminating against anyone because of political beliefs or affiliations.

ai.title: Political Neutrality
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Walang favoritism o discrimination base sa political beliefs o party affiliation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Serbisyo para sa lahat — anuman ang partido o paniniwala.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: Tulungan ang lahat ng mamamayan, hindi lang ang kakampi sa pulitika.
ai.prompt: Explain political neutrality in public service.

paragraphs.label: 5. Responsiveness to the Public:
paragraphs.text: Public officials must provide prompt, adequate, and efficient service to the people.

ai.title: Responsiveness to the Public
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mabilis, sapat, at efficient na serbisyo sa publiko.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Huwag pabayaan ang mga tanong o request ng mamamayan — aksyunan agad.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: Proseso ng dokumento sa loob ng required period.
ai.prompt: Explain responsiveness to the public with examples.

paragraphs.label: 6. Nationalism and Patriotism:
paragraphs.text: Public officials must remain loyal to the country and promote the welfare of the Filipino people.

ai.title: Nationalism and Patriotism
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Loyalty sa bansa at pag-promote ng welfare ng Filipino people.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Protektahan ang public resources at suportahan ang programs para sa bansa.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: Huwag magnakaw ng pondo — gamitin ito para sa bayan.
ai.prompt: Explain nationalism and patriotism in public service.

paragraphs.label: 7. Commitment to Democracy:
paragraphs.text: Public officials must respect democratic principles, constitutional rights, and the authority of the people.

ai.title: Commitment to Democracy
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Igalang ang democratic principles, constitutional rights, at authority ng taong-bayan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ang mamamayan ang boss — respetuhin ang kanilang karapatan.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: Respetuhin ang karapatang magpahayag ng opinyon nang mapayapa.
ai.prompt: Explain commitment to democracy with examples.

paragraphs.label: 8. Simple Living:
paragraphs.text: Public officials and employees must lead modest lives appropriate to their positions and income.

ai.title: Simple Living
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Mamuhay nang simple at naaayon sa lawful income.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Huwag magpakita ng extravagant na yaman na hindi tugma sa sahod.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Halimbawa: Iwasan ang mamahaling sasakyan o alahas kung hindi kaya ng suweldo.
ai.prompt: Explain simple living under RA 6713.

ai.title: Mga Prohibited Acts
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Section 7 ng RA 6713 ay naglilista ng mga bawal na gawain para sa public officials at employees.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Layunin ng prohibitions na maiwasan ang conflict of interest at corruption.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang tatanggap ng regalo, misusing confidential info, at conflict of interest ay mga seryosong violations.
ai.prompt: Explain the prohibited acts under Section 7 of RA 6713.

paragraphs.text: Under Section 7 of RA 6713, public officials and employees are prohibited from certain activities, including: having financial or material interests in transactions requiring the approval of their office; misusing confidential government information for personal benefit; soliciting or accepting gifts, favors, loans, or anything of monetary value connected with their official duties or transactions affected by their office, subject to the law's specific exceptions; and engaging in certain outside employment or private activities that conflict with their official responsibilities.

ai.title: Prohibited Acts (Section 7)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Apat na pangunahing prohibited acts:

1. Financial/material interest sa transactions na kailangan ng approval ng office nila
2. Misusing confidential government info para sa personal benefit
3. Soliciting/accepting gifts, favors, loans na may kinalaman sa official duties
4. Outside employment na may conflict sa official responsibilities

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Huwag kumita o makinabang nang personal gamit ang posisyon sa gobyerno.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
May exceptions ang batas sa gifts — pero general rule: bawal tumanggap kapag may kinalaman sa trabaho.
ai.prompt: Explain the prohibited acts under Section 7 of RA 6713 with examples.

sections.heading: SALN (Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth)

ai.title: SALN
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang SALN ay Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth — deklarasyon ng mga ari-arian, utang, net worth, at financial interests.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang "transparency report" ng bawat public official — para makita kung tugma ang yaman sa sahod.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Kasama sa SALN ang mga ari-arian at utang ng asawa at mga anak na wala pang 18 taong gulang.
ai.prompt: Explain what SALN is and its purpose under RA 6713.

paragraphs.text: SALN means Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth. It is a declaration that public officials and employees are generally required to submit under oath to disclose their assets, liabilities, net worth, and certain financial or business interests, including those of their spouses and unmarried children under 18, as provided by law.

ai.title: Ano ang SALN?
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang SALN ay Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth — isang sworn declaration ng lahat ng ari-arian, utang, at financial interests.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Kasama sa SALN ang mga ari-arian at utang ng asawa at mga unmarried children under 18 years old.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Sinasubmit ito under oath — meaning, may legal consequence kapag nag-falsify.
ai.prompt: Explain SALN in detail with the requirement for spouse and minor children.

paragraphs.label: Example:
paragraphs.text: A government employee must declare their properties, financial liabilities, and other reportable interests in their SALN.

ai.title: Halimbawa ng SALN
ai.content:
Tanong: Paano ginagawa ang SALN?
Sagot: Inililista ng empleyado ang lahat ng properties (bahay, lupa, sasakyan), liabilities (utang sa bangko, credit card), at net worth (assets minus liabilities).
ai.prompt: Explain what goes into a SALN with examples.

ai.title: Gabay sa Peace and Human Rights
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang peace and human rights ay tumutukoy sa pagpapanatili ng kapayapaan at pagprotekta sa mga pangunahing karapatan at dignidad ng bawat tao.

🔍 Breakdown
• UDHR — Universal Declaration of Human Rights
• Civil at Political Rights
• Economic, Social, Cultural Rights
• Equality at Non-Discrimination
• Peacebuilding
• Human Dignity

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Lahat ng tao ay nararapat tratuhin nang patas at may respeto, anuman ang kasarian, relihiyon, lahi, paniniwala, o estado sa buhay. Hindi lang ito tungkol sa kawalan ng gulo — kasama rin ang katarungan, pagkakapantay-pantay, kalayaan, at paggalang.

📦 Halimbawa
• Right to Life: Karapatang mabuhay at maprotektahan laban sa ilegal na pagkitil.
• Freedom of Expression: Malayang pagpapahayag ng opinyon.
• Equality: Pantay na pagtrato sa lahat.
• Peacebuilding: Pag-usapan ang hindi pagkakaunawaan, hindi karahasan.
• Human Dignity: Walang dapat maliitin o ipahiya.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito?
Core values ito ng isang demokratikong lipunan. Madalas itong lumabas sa CSE — lalo na ang UDHR at human rights principles.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
• UDHR — Adopted on December 10, 1948 ng UN General Assembly
• Human Rights — Basic rights ng bawat tao
• Peacebuilding — Preventing at resolving conflicts through peaceful means
• Equality — Equal dignity without unfair discrimination

🎯 Exam Tip
Memorize ang petsa ng UDHR (December 10, 1948) at ang UN General Assembly bilang nag-adopt nito — madalas itong tanong.
ai.prompt: Explain peace and human rights in simple Tagalog — UDHR, civil/political rights, economic/social rights, equality, peacebuilding, and human dignity — with CSE exam tips.

ai.title: Kahulugan ng Peace and Human Rights
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang peace ay pagpapanatili ng peaceful relationships at pag-iwas sa violence. Ang human rights ay basic rights at freedoms ng lahat ng tao.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Hindi lang ito kawalan ng gulo — kasama ang justice, equality, at paggalang sa dignidad ng bawat isa.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Universal ang human rights — para sa lahat, walang exception.
ai.prompt: Explain what peace and human rights mean.

paragraphs.text: Peace and human rights refer to the promotion of peaceful relationships, justice, equality, respect, and protection of the inherent dignity and fundamental rights of every human being. Human rights are basic rights and freedoms that belong to all individuals regardless of nationality, race, sex, religion, language, social status, or other personal circumstances. Peace involves preventing violence, resolving conflicts through peaceful means, respecting differences, and promoting cooperation within communities and nations.

ai.title: Ano ang Peace and Human Rights?
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang peace ay pag-iwas sa violence at peaceful resolution ng conflict. Ang human rights ay basic rights ng lahat ng tao, anuman ang lahi, kasarian, relihiyon, o estado.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Universal ito — hindi pwedeng bawiin ng kahit sino, kahit gobyerno.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang peace ay hindi lang absence of war — kasama ang justice at equality.
ai.prompt: Explain this definition of peace and human rights with examples.

ai.title: Mahahalagang Konsepto
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Anim na mahalagang konsepto sa peace and human rights: UDHR, civil/political rights, economic/social/cultural rights, equality, peacebuilding, human dignity.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawat isa ay nagpoprotekta sa iba't ibang aspeto ng buhay ng tao — mula sa basic rights hanggang sa dignity.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang UDHR (1948) ang pinaka-fundamental na international document sa human rights.
ai.prompt: Explain the six key concepts in peace and human rights.

paragraphs.label: 1. Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR):
paragraphs.text: The UDHR is an international declaration adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on December 10, 1948. It establishes a common standard of fundamental human rights and freedoms for all people.

ai.title: UDHR
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang UDHR ay international declaration na in-adopt ng UN General Assembly noong December 10, 1948. Ito ang common standard ng human rights para sa lahat ng tao.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Ito ang pinaka-fundamental na dokumento ng human rights sa buong mundo — sinusunod ng maraming bansa.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
December 10, 1948 — madalas lumabas sa exam.
ai.prompt: Explain the UDHR and its significance.

paragraphs.text: Important rights recognized include: right to life, liberty, and security; right to equality before the law; freedom of thought, religion, and expression; right to education; right to work; right to participate in government; right against torture and slavery.

ai.title: Mga Karapatan sa UDHR
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pitong mahalagang karapatan sa UDHR:

1. Right to life, liberty, and security
2. Equality before the law
3. Freedom of thought, religion, expression
4. Right to education
5. Right to work
6. Right to participate in government
7. Right against torture and slavery

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Lahat ng ito ay basic rights — walang dapat mabawasan kahit kanino.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Right against torture at slavery — pinaka-basic na karapatan ng tao.
ai.prompt: Explain the rights enumerated in the UDHR.

paragraphs.label: 2. Civil and Political Rights:
paragraphs.text: These protect an individual's freedom and participation in society and government. Example: The right to vote, freedom of speech, and freedom of religion.

ai.title: Civil at Political Rights
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang civil at political rights ay nagpoprotekta sa freedom at participation sa society at government.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Right to vote, freedom of speech, freedom of religion — mga karapatang pampulitika at personal.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Civil = personal freedoms; Political = participation sa government.

paragraphs.label: 3. Economic, Social, and Cultural Rights:

ai.title: Gabay sa Environmental Management
ai.content:

Ang environmental management ay responsible planning, protection, conservation, at sustainable use ng natural resources.

• RA 9003 — Ecological Solid Waste Management
• RA 8749 — Clean Air Act
• RA 9275 — Clean Water Act
• RA 6969 — Toxic Substances at Hazardous Wastes
• RA 9729 — Climate Change Act
• RA 9512 — Environmental Awareness and Education

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Layunin nitong maiwasan ang polusyon, pagkasira ng kalikasan, at pagkaubos ng resources — para mapakinabangan pa ito ng susunod na henerasyon.

📦 Halimbawa
• RA 9003: Paghihiwalay ng biodegradable, recyclable, residual, special waste.
• RA 8749: Kontrol sa usok ng sasakyan at pabrika.
• RA 9275: Huwag magtapon ng wastewater sa ilog.
• RA 9729: Paghahanda sa bagyo at baha.
• Reforestation: Pagtatanim ng puno sa kalbong lugar.

ai.content:

Responsible planning, protection, conservation, at sustainable use ng natural resources.

Kasama rito ang pagsunod sa batas, tamang waste disposal, conservation, at pangangalaga sa halaman at hayop.

ai.title: Philippine Environmental Laws
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Anim na pangunahing environmental laws sa Pilipinas.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Bawat batas ay may specific na focus: waste, air, water, toxic, climate, education.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Ang RA numbers ay madalas i-match sa description — memorized dapat.
ai.prompt: Explain the six main Philippine environmental laws.

paragraphs.label: 1. RA 9003 – Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000:
paragraphs.text: This law establishes a systematic program for managing solid waste through waste reduction, segregation, recycling, composting, and proper disposal. Example: Households should separate biodegradable, recyclable, residual, and special waste to support proper waste management.

ai.title: RA 9003 (Solid Waste)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 9003 ay batas tungkol sa waste reduction, segregation, recycling, composting, at proper disposal.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Paghihiwalay ng biodegradable, recyclable, residual, at special waste — ito ang core.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 9003 = Solid Waste Management.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 9003 Ecological Solid Waste Management Act.

paragraphs.label: 2. RA 8749 – Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999:
paragraphs.text: This law aims to protect and maintain clean air by preventing and controlling air pollution. Example: Factories and vehicles must comply with applicable emission standards to reduce harmful air pollutants.

ai.title: RA 8749 (Clean Air)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 8749 ay batas para sa clean air — prevention at control ng air pollution.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Factories at vehicles dapat sumunod sa emission standards.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 8749 = Clean Air Act.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 8749 Clean Air Act.

paragraphs.label: 3. RA 9275 – Philippine Clean Water Act of 2004:
paragraphs.text: This law aims to protect the country's water resources by preventing and controlling water pollution. Example: Factories must properly manage wastewater instead of releasing untreated industrial waste into rivers.

ai.title: RA 9275 (Clean Water)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 9275 ay batas para sa water resources — prevention at control ng water pollution.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Factories dapat i-manage ang wastewater — hindi ito itinatapon sa ilog.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 9275 = Clean Water Act.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 9275 Clean Water Act.

paragraphs.label: 4. RA 6969 – Toxic Substances and Hazardous and Nuclear Wastes Control Act of 1990:
paragraphs.text: This law regulates the importation, manufacture, processing, distribution, use, and disposal of chemical substances and hazardous and nuclear wastes. Example: Hazardous chemical waste must be handled and disposed of according to applicable safety and environmental regulations.

ai.title: RA 6969 (Toxic Substances)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 6969 ay nagre-regulate ng chemical substances at hazardous/nuclear wastes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Toxic at nuclear wastes ay may special handling rules — hindi pwedeng basta itapon.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 6969 = Toxic Substances and Hazardous Wastes.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 6969 Toxic Substances Control Act.

paragraphs.label: 5. RA 9729 – Climate Change Act of 2009:
paragraphs.text: This law integrates climate change considerations into government policies and establishes the Climate Change Commission. Example: Government agencies develop programs to prepare communities for climate-related risks such as floods, droughts, and stronger typhoons.

ai.title: RA 9729 (Climate Change)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 9729 ay nag-iintegrate ng climate change sa government policies at nagtatag ng Climate Change Commission.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Paghahanda sa floods, droughts, stronger typhoons — climate adaptation.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 9729 = Climate Change Act. Nagtatag ito ng Climate Change Commission.
ai.prompt: Explain RA 9729 Climate Change Act.

paragraphs.label: 6. RA 9512 – National Environmental Awareness and Education Act of 2008:
paragraphs.text: This law promotes environmental awareness through environmental education in schools and other learning institutions. Example: Schools conduct environmental activities and lessons about pollution prevention, conservation, and waste management.

ai.title: RA 9512 (Environmental Education)
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Ang RA 9512 ay nagpo-promote ng environmental awareness through education sa schools.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Environmental education sa curriculum — para maging aware ang mga estudyante.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
RA 9512 = Environmental Awareness and Education Act.

ai.title: Mga Environmental Practices
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pitong karaniwang environmental practices na dapat gawin ng bawat isa.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Simpleng aksyon ito sa araw-araw — waste segregation, recycling, composting, at iba pa.

ai.prompt: Explain the seven important environmental practices.

paragraphs.text: Important environmental management practices include: Waste Segregation (separating waste according to type), Recycling (processing used materials into new products), Composting (turning biodegradable waste into organic fertilizer), Reforestation (planting trees to restore forests), Water Conservation (avoiding unnecessary water consumption), Energy Conservation (reducing unnecessary electricity use), and Biodiversity Conservation (protecting different species of plants, animals, and their natural habitats).

ai.title: Pitong Environmental Practices
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan
Pitong practices:

1. Waste Segregation — paghihiwalay ng basura by type
2. Recycling — processing used materials into new products
3. Composting — biodegradable waste → organic fertilizer
4. Reforestation — tree planting para restore forests
5. Water Conservation — tipirin ang tubig
6. Energy Conservation — tipirin ang kuryente
7. Biodiversity Conservation — protektahan ang species at habitats

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag
Lahat ito ay kaya mong gawin sa araw-araw — maliit man, malaking tulong.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan
Segregation at recycling — pinaka-basic at madalas lumabas sa exam.
